label: observed_seats: remaining seats when the bus actually reached the target stop (0..70)
weights: 1/m per arrival group (m questions answer the same arrival)

features.f_horizon_stops: stops between the bus and the target stop
features.p_seats_left_ratio: A18: seats now / vehicle's max eligible seats seen so far
features.p_maximum_seats_ratio: A18: vehicle max seats seen / 68 (capacity proxy)
features.p_seat_slope: A18: seats now minus seats in the immediately previous linked batch
features.p_full_seat_streak: A18: consecutive full stops along the linked chain (30 min window)
features.p_prev_is_full: A18: preceding vehicle (first in-window entry at this stop) was full
features.p_prev_seats_ratio: A18: preceding vehicle seats / this vehicle's capacity proxy
features.p_stop_position: A18: target stop order / largest stop order of the route version
features.x_route_code: route identity code (0..19); 12 of 20 routes have no TRAIN rows
features.x_prev_gap_seconds: seconds between the preceding vehicle's and this vehicle's entry at the stop
features.x_source_position: current passed stop / largest stop order
features.s_fill_rate_score: A18 col 29: z score of how full this route's buses usually are on arrival at the target stop (route version x time slot, available as of the forecast)
features.s_net_boarding_segment_score: A18 col 30: summed z score of usual seat loss over the stops between now and the target
features.s_filled_by_neighbours: A18 col 31: target stop has no cell; neighbour cells were used

featureSets.NO_STOP: all but the three s_ columns
